mapper.select: SELECT b.`classes_id` as `id`, b.`name`, b.`start_work_time`, b.`end_work_time`, a.`state`, a.`clock_type`, a.`actual_clock_in_time` FROM `att_clock_in_records` a INNER JOIN `att_classes_record` b ON a.`classes_id` = b.`classes_id` AND a.`classes_version` = b.`version` where a.`clock_in_date` = #{clockInDate} and a.`user_id` = #{userId} and a.`clock_type` in ('START', 'END') order by require_clock_in_time,clock_type desc

select `user_id`,`user_name`,`clock_in_date`,`clock_type`,`state`,count(1) as `num` from `att_clock_in_records` where `clock_type`='START' and `deleted`=0 GROUP BY `user_name`,`clock_in_date`,`classes_id`,`clock_type` HAVING `num`>1
SELECT * FROM `att_clock_in_records` where `user_id`=#{userId} and `clock_after_time` <= #{clockInTime} and `clock_type`='START' ORDER BY `clock_after_time` desc limit 1
